name: Get deferred email count
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current number of deferred emails and related processing status for automation workflows, as shown in the sidebar of the Advanced Automation UI. Use the automation.get_rate_limit_status action instead if you only need rate‑limit information without the deferred count.

processingStatus.description: Overall health status of the automation processing engine.

deferredEmailCount.description: Number of emails currently deferred from sending.

rateLimit.description: Maximum number of emails that can be processed per second.

maxDelay.description: Maximum allowed delay in seconds before processing deferred emails.

hours.description: Current delay expressed in whole hours.

minutes.description: Current delay expressed in whole minutes.
